title: Should AI Mimic People? Understanding AI-Supported Writing Technology Among Black Users
reasoning: The paper is a qualitative human-centered computing (HCI) study focused on racial bias, cultural alignment, and user perceptions of AI-supported writing tools among Black American users. While it mentions 'radical care' as an author positionality and cites related work on 'moral' self-correction in LLMs, its core focus is not evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
